place.zh: 沉鼎观 · 山门 · 石坪
place.en: Chending Temple · The gate · the stone yard

setup.zh: 二试在山门里的一方石坪上。地上刻着九宫，缺了几个数。
setup.en: The second trial is on a stone yard inside the gate: a square of nine cut into the ground, some numbers missing.

recap.zh: 二试，洛书九宫：纵、横、斜，都要是十五。
recap.en: Second trial, the Luo Shu square: fifteen down, across and corner to corner.

text.zh: 二试，脑子。填上。纵、横、斜，都要是十五。
text.en: Second, wits. Fill it in. Down, across, corner to corner — fifteen every way.

exits.means: hands in the solved square, or asks to go on to the third trial

refuse.zh: 九宫还没填满。瞿老不看半张卷子。
refuse.en: The square is not filled yet. Elder Qu does not look at half an answer.
